title: Flaky timestamp test
review_caught_issues: review ran; raised a compatibility finding, addressed
notes: Draft PR #10. Right root cause (ms-resolution ISO timestamps tie). Removed the randomness and mocked Date.now so tests are deterministic; no retries, test kept strict. But it fixed it by changing product behaviour: createdAt is bumped +1ms on ties/clock rollback, so it can drift ahead of real time. Relaxing the test to >= or ordering by id was the lighter option; it chose without asking. Tests a bit over-built (epoch-crossing case). Verified: 40/40 full-suite runs pass, 3 new tests fail on old store. Also tested on Node 20.0.0 (engines >=20) and documented 2 pre-existing server-test failures there without fixing them (not verified by me).
